defaults.source: Distilled from [developer.shopware.com](https://developer.shopware.com) plus the Shopware 6.7 source, retrieved 2026-08-20. Conceptual explanations: for implementation, use the other shopware-* plugins.

architecture.title: Shopware architecture concepts
architecture.description: How Shopware works: overall architecture, the DAL, data stores, extension mechanisms, the APIs, the app system, messaging. Use when asked why Shopware works a certain way rather than how to code it.
architecture.intro: The reasoning behind the platform. Answers "why is it built this way", not "how do I write it".

domain.title: Shopware domain concepts
domain.description: Shopware domain concepts: catalogue, checkout, content and CMS, the rule system, translations. Use when asked how a Shopware domain is modelled conceptually.
domain.intro: How Shopware models its business domains, independent of the code that implements them.
